other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India
Applicant must be a domicile/permanent resident of Jammu & Kashmir
Applicant must be deserted, destitute or a widow with no means of livelihood
Children accompanying the mother are entitled to admission, but male children older than 8 years must be transferred to Bal Ashrams
benefits_summary: Inmates receive free food, shelter, bedding, clothing and, for school‑going girls, free education, with care and protection until they are rehabilitated, married, or employed.
